dreamteamer.title: Contacts
dreamteamer.description: The people the operator deals with — `contacts`, each pointing at the `companies` record they work for (the companies module, which this one stamps `companies.contacts` onto) — enriched from LinkedIn through a batched, containerised MCP session (`scraping-contacts`, `/scrape-contact`), tagged by the workspace's own vocabulary (the tags module). Avatars are `assets`; a contact's latest meeting is a peer reference into `meetings`, so this module works without the meeting chain and joins it when present.
